title: Tribunus Server UX — Terminal Dashboard, Model Management, CLI Ergonomics, and Developer Experience for Local Inference
context: The Tribunus server provides core inference functionality but the user experience is clunky — scattered configuration, opaque errors, no model management, no progress indicators. For a desktop-first engine competing with Ollama and LM Studio, the UX is the product.
decision:
## Decision

### Single-Command Bootstrap

`tribunus run <model-name>` downloads, compiles, loads, and serves in one command. Model catalog search (HuggingFace, GGUF registry). Progress bars during download and compilation.

### Status Dashboard

`tribunus ps` shows loaded models, active requests, VRAM, backend, uptime. `--watch` for live terminal UI. `GET /health` returns full state: model, backend, active requests, VRAM, temperature, tokens/sec.

### Diagnostics

`tribunus doctor` checks GPU drivers, model compatibility, disk space, thermal throttling. `tribunus estimate <model>` estimates VRAM needs before download and recommends quantization.

### Compute Image Awareness

`tribunus show <model>` displays compute image: backends targeted, per-phase evidence (latency, GFLOPS), arena plan, receipts. Users can see WHY their model performs the way it does — unique differentiator.

### Configuration

Single `tribunus.jsonc` with schema validation. Priority: CLI > env vars > config file > defaults. Auto-generated by `tribunus init`.

### API

OpenAI-compatible plus: list loaded models with evidence, load/unload models, stream receipts. Swagger at `/docs`, playground at `/playground`.

### CLI Ergonomics

Positional args (`tribunus run <model>`). Colored output, `--json` on all commands. Tab-completion. Progress bars.

### Error UX

Every error includes a fix hint: model not found (suggest alternatives), VRAM full (suggest quantization), backend missing (show install command), GPU not found (list detected).
consequences:
**Positive:** Builds on Ollama/LM Studio patterns. Compute image awareness is unique. Actionable errors.

**Negative:** Large surface to polish. Model catalog requires maintenance.

**Effort:** 3-4 weeks for CLI + API + status dashboard.
